title: add benchmark-lab: adaptive-batching + profiling baselines + reporting pipeline
author: Maya Patel
description: This PR introduces the next iteration of the benchmark-lab work: adaptive batching runners, profiling baselines for representative workloads, and an end-to-end reporting pipeline that sends aggregated results to the perf metrics store and reporting dashboard. Motivation: previously we collected per-run metrics but lacked a unified pipeline and baseline artifacts to compare adaptive-batching strategies across model variants and sequence-length distributions. This change bundles: 1) new adaptive batching runner that exercises dynamic batch sizing and measures latency/P95/throughput over realistic arrival patterns; 2) profiling baseline artifacts (profiling configs + sample KV/cache warmup traces) for the representative workloads used by the lab; 3) Airflow DAG + reporting scripts that ingest raw runner outputs, compute baseline comparisons, generate summary CSV/JSON, and upload to the perf datastore S3 bucket + trigger dashboard rebuild. The description below is a single continuous string and includes the checklist for merge readiness. Checklist: - [x] Add adaptive-batching runner implementation and unit tests - [x] Add representative workload profiling baseline artifacts and sample traces - [x] Add Airflow DAG + reporting scripts with idempotent retries - [x] Add docs + quickstart for running locally and in CI - [x] Run end-to-end locally and validate metrics parity with existing runners Notes: - The adaptive batching runner exposes a metrics facade compatible with existing benchmark-lab Prometheus exporters to minimize dashboard changes. - Profiling baselines include canonical config JSONs for small/medium/large sequence distributions and GPU/kernel selection annotations. - The DAG is guarded: it will only upload to perf S3 when run with the "--upload" flag or when AIRFLOW_ENV=prod. - Performance impact: no runtime change to serving infra; purely bench/testing code and reporting.
